lines.text: Jude, a brother of James, urges the called to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all.
Jesus destroyed unbelievers after leading His people out of Egypt, and Sodom and Gomorrah are an example of eternal fire.
The archangel Gabriel disputed with the devil over the body of Moses and said, "The Lord rebuke you!"
These men traveled the path of Cain, rushed into Balaam's error for profit, and perished in Aaron's rebellion.
The beloved are told to build themselves up in their most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.
